## TRA Timeline

#### Contemplated Up-C IPO and form-of TRA

- 2016-01-07: Initial S-1 describes the contemplated TRA at 85% payment rate covering Section 754 basis step-ups, pre-IPO NOLs, and TRA-imputed interest
- 2016-02-02: S-1/A first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.8 (preamble date blank, signatures absent)
- 2016-02-04: Final S-1/A with substantively identical TRA disclosure

#### Abandonment

- 2018-10-25: SEC STAFF ACTION marks the registration abandoned; IPO never closed and form-of TRA never executed

## Explanation

OTG EXP, Inc. was the shell-form Delaware PubCo for OTG Management's contemplated Up-C IPO, registered across an S-1 and four S-1/A amendments in January and February 2016. The form-of Tax Receivable Agreement was first attached as Exhibit 10.8 to the February 2, 2016 S-1/A, naming OTG EXP, Inc. as Corporate Taxpayer, OTG Management, LLC as the OpCo, and pre-IPO LLC members as Beneficiaries to be listed on a closing-date Exhibit A; the agreement carried an 85% payment rate covering Section 754 basis step-ups from future LLC Unit exchanges, certain pre-IPO net operating loss carryforwards, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments themselves. The IPO never closed, the form-of was never signed, and the SEC marked the registration abandoned via a STAFF ACTION on October 25, 2018. No further filings have appeared under this CIK. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
